history.overview: Hollows North formed along a natural ridge used by Dragorn scouts and later seized by Muramite overwatch forces.

timeline.name: Ridge Formation
timeline.description: Dragorn miners carved upward tunnels forming natural ridges.

timeline.name: Muramite Seizure
timeline.description: Muramite overwatch squads took control of the elevated ledges.

timeline.name: Discord Frost
timeline.description: Discord energy created frost pockets and arcane freeze zones.

timeline.name: Resistance Runners
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels used ridge paths to bypass Muramite patrols.
